card.name: Next step in mixing or cooking directions
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', or the last ingredient word in a list within an 'add X to Y' instruction, just before the next action verb like mix, stir, cook or shake. Seen in preparation directions for medicines and recipes.

modes.label: Joining word before next action
modes.description: A comma or 'and' after an added ingredient, right before a verb like stir, cook, mix or shake.
modes.example: Add flour<< and>> cook, stirring constantly, until no dry

modes.label: Ingredient or liquid noun
modes.description: The last noun of an add-this instruction, such as water or salsa, before the step continues.
modes.example: Add 67 mL of<< water>> in two portions.

modes.label: Comma after liquid or powder in mixing
modes.description: A comma after a mixing medium in a drug preparation step, before the instruction to mix or shake.
modes.example: add the entire capsule content of each capsule into the applesauce or yogurt<<,>> then mix the entire dose into the apples
